title: Linked devices
summary: Lists the other devices of the account with their last use, starts Link a computer, and signs out one device after a biometric check, on the MAS page that ends that device's session (ADR 0116).

deviceId.description: The Matrix device ID. Never shown as text.

displayName.description: The device name; bipe_linked_devices_unknown_name when empty.

phase.description: loaded with an empty list shows bipe_linked_devices_empty.

devices.description: The other devices of the account, newest use first. This phone is not in it.

signOutCandidate.description: The device that the sign-out sheet asks about.

signOutPhase.description: loading: the MAS page loads or the web view signs in. page: the MAS page that ends the session is in front.

appear.effect: GET /_matrix/client/v3/devices with the access token. Drops this phone (Client.deviceId) and sorts by last use.

askSignOut.effect: Shows the sheet with bipe_linked_devices_sign_out_title (the device name) and bipe_linked_devices_sign_out_body.

confirmSignOut.effect: Asks for the biometric check with bipe_linked_devices_sign_out_biometric. On a pass, opens the private web view of link-computer-approve on the MAS account page with action org.matrix.session_end and the device ID, and fills the MAS login form once with the hidden password. The user confirms on the MAS page.

pageClosed.effect: When the user leaves or closes the MAS page: clears the web view, POST /v1/web-link/finish, reloads the list. A device that is gone from the list shows bipe_app_linked_devices_signed_out.

notes: The SDK has no device list in the FFI and Client.accountUrl returns nothing for an m.login.password session, so the app calls GET /_matrix/client/v3/devices (Matrix spec) and builds the MAS account URL from the auth metadata (MSC2965 account_management_uri, then action=org.matrix.session_end&device_id=<id>). Bipe logic: BipeMatrixAccountAPI.devices and authMetadata, BipeWebLink.sessionEndURL (BipeKit BipeWebLink.swift); BipeWebLinkSession.otherDevices, BipeWebApprovalController purpose SignOut (libraries/bipe weblink).

The private web view, the host rule and the one-time form fill are the same as link-computer-approve. The sign-out flow has no warning and no cooldown, but has the biometric check before the hidden password is read.
A web device is unattested (ADR 0043). This list shows no badge for any device.
bipe_linked_devices_title and the row in Sua conta come from registries/settings.json (account, devices, linkedDevices). This phone shows as the thisDevice info row there, not in this list.
Signing out this phone is sign-out, not this screen.
